messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Tue 24 Nov
Updated edition: organised events only, no markets. Kingfishr at Apolo tonight is sold out. Barça play away at Sabah Wed 18:45, so bars will show it.

TODAY · Tue 24 Nov

1. Christian Löffler - Until We Meet Again Tour
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 Teatre Coliseum
📊 42 interested on RA
💬 Live show by a well-known German melodic-electronica producer in a big seated Gran Via theatre. The RA count is modest, but it is a touring headline date in a large room: expect several hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2489831

2. FREE GUEST LIST · Moods at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 55 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House night on the 26th floor of the W hotel with the city view, free on the guest list. Listed on four platforms; expect a busy bar-club of 150–250, dressy international crowd.
https://ra.co/events/2569428

3. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Tuesday Meetup
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 27 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,255 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Weekly hosted drinks for founders and startup people, in English: the place to meet new people in tech. Expect 30–50, going by the RSVPs, a second listing on Eventbrite and it running every Tuesday.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/317287981/

4. Cicle Miles Davis: Eddie Henderson Quartet
🕘 Tonight 20:30 → 22:00 · 📍 Jamboree Jazz Club
📊 #7 of 12 on Xceed by popularity · venue has 5 followers on Xceed
💶 €30
💬 US trumpeter Eddie Henderson's quartet playing Miles Davis, part of the Barcelona Jazz Festival, in the cellar club on Plaça Reial. Small seated room, so 100–150 at most; no headcount, the forecast rests on the festival billing.
https://xceed.me/en/barcelona/event/cicle-miles-davis-eddie-henderson-quartet/250172

5. Sala Vivaldi Salsa vs Bachata, Talleres + Baile Social
🕘 Tonight 21:00 → 02:30 · 📍 Sala Vivaldi
📊 24 going on Meetup · group has 21,227 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Salsa and bachata workshops, then social dancing until late; easy to turn up alone and meet people. A weekly night from a 21,000-member group, likely 50–80 on the floor; the RSVP count is the only hard number.
https://www.meetup.com/free-salsa-bachata-masterclass/events/317288907/

TOMORROW · Wed 25 Nov

1. BRESH CLUB
🕘 Wed 23:00 → 06:00 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 1 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 From €15.50
💬 The Argentine party brand, so a largely Argentine and Latin crowd singing along to pop and reggaeton. The forecast rests on its weekly residency in Apolo's main room, not on RA, where the count is negligible: expect several hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2585002

2. Salmo
🕘 Wed, doors 19:30 · 📍 Razzmatazz, Sala 1
📊 Razzmatazz main room; tickets still on sale on the venue's site
💶 €34
💬 Italy's biggest rapper in Razzmatazz's main room: the largest gig of the night, likely well over a thousand and heavily Italian. Tickets were still on sale this evening.
https://www.salarazzmatazz.com/agenda

3. AI AFTER: BCN Founders & Entrepreneurs Afterwork Hangout @Secret Rooftop
🕘 Wed 19:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Club 23 Barcelona
📊 52 going on Meetup · group has 141 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Hosted afterwork for founders and people in AI on a rooftop, in English; €5 at the door includes a drink. Expect 50–70, based on the RSVPs and a second listing on Eventbrite.
https://www.meetup.com/bcn-ai-circle-for-entrepreneurs/events/317302598/

4. VYBE l City Hall BARCELONA l BOUNCE ALL NIGHT LONG
🕘 Wed 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 City Hall
📊 172 interested on RA · also on Xceed
💶 Free guest list · paid €7–30
💬 Bouncy, bass-heavy club night in a mid-size club off Plaça Catalunya, free on the guest list. The strongest RA number of the day and also on Xceed: expect a full room of a few hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2581398

5. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF, Victor Hugo & friends
🕘 Wed 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Chica Club
📊 153 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free house and electronica party run by a local DJ collective at a newer club. Solid RA interest plus an Eventbrite listing: expect a couple of hundred, local-leaning crowd.
https://ra.co/events/2552961

Scanned: Meetup 236 · RA 20 · DICE 12 · Xceed 12 · Eventbrite 125 · Luma 10 · Instagram 27 posts + 21 stories.
